mapper.insert: insert into operation_log(employee_id, employee_name, module, operation, method, params, ip, create_time) values(#{employeeId}, #{employeeName}, #{module}, #{operation}, #{method}, #{params}, #{ip}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
select * from operation_log
and module = #{module}
and (employee_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or operation like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by create_time desc
